en: The postcard depicts a tree-lined avenue with a large house or villa on the left. A man with two dogs walks down the gravel path, with green fields and a forested hill in the background. The top of the image reads 'Bad Pyrmont' and 'Allee zum Bomberg.' The reverse side features handwritten German text, a stamp from the Deutsches Reich, and addresses in Göttingen. There are also stamps from 'Städt. Museum Göttingen' and 'Museum im Schloss Bad Pyrmont.'
